headline: Army Bomber Slams Into Empire State Building; 14 Dead, Floors Ablaze
dispatch: A twin-engine B-25 Army bomber plowed into the 79th floor of the Empire State Building in New York City on Saturday morning, killing 14 people and setting several floors ablaze. The pilot, lost in heavy fog, had been attempting to navigate to Newark Airport when the aircraft struck the skyscraper at roughly 200 miles per hour. Rescue workers pulled survivors from burning offices as flaming wreckage fell to the streets 900 feet below.
answer: B-25 bomber crashes into the Empire State Building, 1945
